summary.name: Otter.ai
summary.one_liner: Otter.ai is an AI meeting agent and notetaker that transcribes meetings, generates summaries and action items, and answers questions across meeting recordings.
use_cases: capturing action items and assigning follow-ups
syncing sales call notes to a CRM
transcribing uploaded audio or video files
searching past meeting knowledge with AI chat
automatically joining scheduled Zoom, Teams, or Meet calls
summary.what_it_does: Otter records or joins meetings and produces real-time transcripts with speaker recognition and multi-language support. It generates summaries with decisions, action items, and key takeaways. Otter AI Chat searches across meetings and connected apps to answer questions and draft follow-ups or reports. The page also describes pre-call briefing documents, live coaching prompts, and automatic extraction of deal details to a CRM. Users can upload audio and video files for transcription and share or edit the resulting notes.
notable: Bot-free recording from Mac or Windows desktop and Chrome
AI Chat searches across meetings and connected apps
MCP Server lets ChatGPT and Claude access meeting knowledge
Auto-joins scheduled Zoom, Microsoft Teams, and Google Meet meetings
caveats: Team plan lists 6000 monthly transcription minutes with 4 hours per conversation
Advanced workspace, admin, and enterprise features require contacting sales
Free tier details beyond the listed features are not stated on the page
